ground_truth: Well, in the first place, Mr. Faulkner is not original at all. When Mr. Faulkner or anyone else says, wait, you must bear in mind that citizens in this country have been waiting since 1863 when the Emancipation Proclamation was put forth. We've been waiting since the 14th Amendment was adopted. As a matter of fact, I would say that the organization's more reasonable criticism is that we're moving too slow.
